items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And then she married my grandfather... And your grandmother's name? Virginia Edwards. Virginia Edwards. Yeah.

ctx.x: And that probably is the reason why her maiden name was Virginia Edwards. Okay. And then she married my grandfather, who was an interpreter in World War I. And he, actually he's an African, French African, because he interpreted English, you know, French English for generals in the First World War. And then he came to America and so forth, back in the earlier days, before that.
